source.attribution: NeqSim master, SystemPrEos with the matching AttractiveTerm* - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: Delft (1998): a fitted cubic for methane, the 1978 Peng-Robinson Soave form for every other component. azoth carries the methane flag as a per-component parameter resolved from the name, keeping `Component` name-free.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(7)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.8470804194612649
  k    [8.3955496276076, 0.33419665927591624]
  x    [0.08259200947280676, 0.9174079905271932]
  y    [0.6934053143727822, 0.30659468562721764]
  Zl   0.0934606764907983
  Zv   0.877354596737476

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
